base_dir_check.inside_sibling_repo: Accepted: base dir permits multiple repos, not one pinned repo.

base_dir_check.outside_followup_git_status: Both implicit and explicit path calls rejected: Path traversal detected.
base_dir_check.source_explanation: git_set_working_dir and git_clone declare skipPathResolution:true. The setter directly validates/stores a repository path and returns repository metadata snapshot; git_clone uses the supplied destination directly. Most normal Git handlers use common GIT_BASE_DIR path resolution, and tested git_status outside the root was rejected with Path traversal detected. GIT_BASE_DIR is not an OS sandbox.
base_dir_check.outside_git_clone: git_clone with a local synthetic source succeeded; destination was outside GIT_BASE_DIR; cloned HEAD independently matched source HEAD.
base_dir_check.clone_cleanup: Stopped the MCP process first, verified task-owned destination origin, HEAD and exact expected contents, then removed it; raw evidence confirms server_process_exited=true and clone_destination_removed=true.
